request.received: <tc:text><tc:accent>{sender}</tc:accent> wants to be your friend. <click:run_command:'/friend accept {sender}'><hover:show_text:'<tc:text>Accept the friend request from <tc:accent>{sender}</tc:accent>'><tc:accent>[Accept]</tc:accent></hover></click>
error.self: <tc:error>You cannot add yourself. Enter another player's name.
error.duplicate: <tc:error>You already sent a request to <tc:accent>{target}</tc:accent>. Wait for their answer.
error.cooldown: <tc:error>You must wait a bit before sending another request to <tc:accent>{target}</tc:accent>.
error.norequest: <tc:error>No pending request from <tc:accent>{target}</tc:accent>. Check your requests with <tc:accent>/friend requests</tc:accent>.
list.empty: <tc:text>You have no friends yet. <click:suggest_command:'/friend add '><hover:show_text:'<tc:text>Put the command into your chat'><tc:accent>/friend add \<player></tc:accent></hover></click>
